rules.boundary: All 36 pairs and their interpretation metadata must match exactly in all three repetitions and all four processes.
rules.gates: Apply the existing HDRGates evaluator to each complete set of 36 measurements. All G1 through G4 checks must pass unchanged in every repetition.
rules.variability: Evaluate each case and output field separately. A changed field under the same binary and from exact inputs demonstrates framework variability for that case and field. A field that differs across backends without a corresponding same-binary change remains unresolved. No observed maximum becomes a tolerance.
rules.scope: This host, Xcode, Swift toolchain, framework versions, fixture corpus and render configuration only.
